newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary OTP Sec. says FX bonds oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Hungary OTP Sec. says FX bonds oversubscribed.

text.p: Hungary's OTP Ertekpapir Rt, the securities arm of the OTP financial group said on Thursday that its "OTP Broker FX 98" bonds were oversubscribed and subscriptions were closed on July 16.
"Total subscription exceeded 2.9 billion forints," OTP Ertekpapir Rt said in a statement, but added the figures were not yet final.
OTP Ertekpapir publicly issued floating rate one-year bearer bonds of up to one billion forints to invest in futures and forward deals.

OTP Ertekpapir, which marked investments in this bond as risky because of the nature of forex markets, wants to invest in currency futures deals on the Budapest Commgdity Exchange, in forward deals on the interbank market and in BUX index futures on the Budapest Stock Exchange..
The bonds will be listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
